# Serpzilla

> > Serpzilla is an automated link building marketplace offering niche edits, guest posts, and contextual backlinks across 150,000+ websites for SEO professionals.

Serpzilla provides a comprehensive platform for buying and selling backlinks, with services including link insertion, guest posting, tier 2 links, and sitewide backlinks. The platform serves both SEO agencies seeking quality backlinks and publishers looking to monetize their websites through link placement.

## Link Building Services

- [Buy Niche Edits for Link Building at Serpzilla](https://serpzilla.com/serpzilla-backlinks): Niche edits backlinks with indexing guarantee and monthly payment

- [Link Insertion in articles, news, reviews on authority sites with DR](https://serpzilla.com/insertion-backlinks): Link insertion service placing links in high-ranking existing content
- [Buy Contextual Backlinks at the Link building Platform](https://serpzilla.com/content-backlinks): Contextual backlinks on relevant pages from 1 cent, Google penalty safe
